thread:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER — P1 GPU capacity exhaustion detected in us-west-2. gpu_queue_depth > 1200 for 6m, sustained latency spikes on inference routes. autoscaler errors observed: node attach failures. Incident INC-8539 created. https://redwood.incidents/INC-8539

sre-bot: Incident channel created: #inc-8539 (P1) — paging oncall. Logging autoscaler stream to thread.

emily: ack. I'm oncall. looking at autoscaler logs and queue dashboard now. posting initial impact: 4 high-value customers seeing 5-10s extra latency, a small fraction of requests 504ing.

jamal: digging in logs — hitting repeated AWS error when ASG tries to attach new GPU node: `AttachRolePolicyNotFound: Instance profile arn:aws:iam::111111111111:instance-profile/redwood-gpu-instance-profile not found`
```
# autoscaler stderr snippet
2026-03-15T21:02:13Z ERROR autoscaler: failed to attach node: AttachRolePolicyNotFound: Instance profile not found
  at github.com/redwood/autoscaler/aws.(*attach).Attach(attach.go:94)
  ...
```

jamal: also seeing launch template ID mismatch — desired LT `lt-0a1b2c7d9` has `IamInstanceProfile` set, but ASG currently launching with LT v3 which lacks the instance profile block.

tanaka: confirmed. CI rollout for the GPU LT bumped to v9 (correct profile), but an older ASG rollback left LT v3 active in the GPU pool group. ASG still references v3 -> no profile -> attach failure.

emily: immediate mitigations: 1) throttle non-essential traffic to reduce queue growth 2) manual provision fallback GPU to buy time 3) route latency-tolerant customers to CPU-only lane where possible. executing now.

ops-bot: Manual provisioning started: creating one p4d.8xlarge via console in us-west-2 to get immediate capacity. ETA ~8m.

customer-success: FYI, we're drafting a short customer note. cc @emily for impact details.

jamal: while ops-provisioning, we can try patching ASG to point to LT v9. planning a controlled update — will require rolling replace of pending nodes. risk: short temporary extra failures if nodes restart.

emily: do it. prioritize attachProfile so new nodes can register. Jamal — run the LT patch and watch autoscaler logs. I'll keep queue throttling live.

jamal: patch applied: `aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name redwood-gpu-pool-usw2 --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0a1b2c7d9,Version=9`
logs:
```
2026-03-15T21:14:05Z INFO autoscaler: detected new LT version for ASG redwood-gpu-pool-usw2 -> 9
2026-03-15T21:16:20Z INFO aws: ASG launching instance i-0f4a6b2c with profile redwood-gpu-instance-profile
2026-03-15T21:17:10Z INFO kube: node gpu-usw2-022 registered, taint `gpu-dedicated=true:NoSchedule` applied
```

emily: good sign. queue depth trending down from 1200 -> 420 in last 12m. still seeing a couple of old pending pods stuck waiting for nodes.

tanaka: a couple more followups planned: 1) fix CI to prevent LT rollback (investigate why Terraform state drifted) 2) add autoscaler healthcheck for AttachRole errors (bubble up to paging) 3) add a runbook step to check LT version vs ASG on high queue alerts.

ops-bot: Manual node is up: i-0f4a6b2c (p4d) registered and scheduling pods. Removing temporary manual node after stable.

emily: routing update — toggled fallback route for low-priority inference to CPU pool: `POST /api/v1/routing/override` (internal) successful. reduced inbound load on GPU workers by ~18%. :thumbsup:

customer-success: sent initial notification to affected customers with note about mitigation and ETA for full restore. link to incident page included.

jamal: autoscaler logs now show healthy attach flow. No new AttachRoleNotFound errors after LT update. Monitoring for 30m.

maria: I will take the bridge at 21:30 UTC for post-incident wrap and customer follow-up. emily — handing off. summary: cause = launch template drift -> ASG launching old LT missing instance profile -> attach failures -> autoscaler couldn't add nodes -> queue growth. mitigations completed: LT patched, manual node provision, traffic throttling, CPU fallback routing.

emily: handing off to @maria for evening oncall. key action items for postmortem: - prevent LT drift (state/CI check) - surface AttachRole failures earlier - improve autoscaler retry/backoff and fallback to dedicated hotpool - add runbook step to temporarily re-route noncritical traffic.

maria: ack. I'll keep monitoring and start coordinating postmortem doc. tagging eng-runtime, eng-infra, devex. :eyes:

ops-bot: Marking manual provision node for termination in 40m unless otherwise requested.

customer-success: customers acknowledged the update, one asked for SLA credit assessment if incidents >10m. capturing for SRE postmortem.

jamal: follow-up note — autoscaler should not swallow AttachRole errors; we need a metric that increases when attach failures > X/m and trigger paging. filing task: AUTOSCALE-1529.

emily: closing incident channel later after stable period. great work team. postmortem owner: tanaka. oncall followup owner: maria.

sre-bot: Incident INC-8539 RESOLVED (services recovered, queue stabilized). Summary appended in incident log.
